info.title: Coussema Public API
info.summary: Programmable SMS delivery, campaign orchestration, contacts, API keys, and webhook endpoints.
info.description: Coussema expose une API publique pour envoyer des SMS, gérer les contacts, créer des campagnes et configurer des webhooks sur la même logique métier que le dashboard.

servers.description: Relative base path on the API host.

tags.name: Platform
tags.description: Service discovery, health, and machine-readable API metadata.

tags.name: SMS
tags.description: Single-recipient SMS sends from the developer API.

tags.name: WhatsApp
tags.description: Coussema WhatsApp template sends, service-window replies, and customer-safe read collections.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Organization account state, entitlements, and invoice-ready usage history.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Create and list outbound SMS campaigns.

tags.name: Sender IDs
tags.description: List approved sender identities and request new ones for review.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Manage organization API keys for the developer product.

get.description: Returns the current API version, the public docs path, and the machine-readable OpenAPI document path.

200.description: API discovery metadata with docs and health paths.

get.description: Lightweight health probe for uptime and platform status checks.
Returns the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 contract generated from the shared Zod schemas.

200.description: The current OpenAPI 3.1 document for the public API.

post.description: Enqueues and dispatches one SMS through the active supplier resolution flow for the authenticated organization.

202.description: SMS accepted by the platform and queued for supplier dispatch.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated WhatsApp message history for the authenticated organization. Provider message IDs, operator errors, and raw upstream payloads are never returned.

post.description: Accepts an approved utility/authentication template send or a service-window text reply for the authenticated organization. The public response returns the Coussema message id and keeps provider message ids hidden.

202.description: WhatsApp message accepted by the platform.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated WhatsApp templates available to the authenticated organization, with local Coussema disabled templates excluded.
Returns cursor-paginated WhatsApp conversations with service-window timestamps for the authenticated organization.
Returns the authenticated organization commercial state, current subscription, and remaining quota.
Returns cursor-paginated usage and quota adjustment entries for the authenticated organization.
Returns a cursor-paginated collection of organization contacts.

post.description: Creates one organization contact and normalizes phone/tags server-side.

delete.description: Deletes one organization contact by identifier.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated campaigns for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Creates one immediate or scheduled SMS campaign on the shared organization-centric runtime.

get.description: Returns the authenticated organization sender IDs, including approval status and default selection.

200.description: Current sender IDs for the organization.

post.description: Creates or reopens a sender ID request for the authenticated organization. Approval remains operator and admin controlled.

get.description: Lists the organization API keys visible to the authenticated principal, paginated by cursor.

post.description: Creates a new organization API key and returns the plaintext secret exactly once.

delete.description: Revokes one organization API key by identifier.

get.description: Lists outbound webhook endpoints configured for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Registers a webhook endpoint and returns its signing secret once at creation time.

200.description: Created webhook endpoint and signing secret.

delete.description: Disables an existing outbound webhook endpoint by identifier.

bearerApiKey.description: Send your Coussema API key as Authorization: Bearer <api-key>.

xApiKey.name: x-api-key
xApiKey.description: Alternative header for clients that cannot send Authorization.

RequestIdHeader.name: x-request-id
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional caller-supplied correlation identifier. The API always echoes a request id in responses.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Recommended for POST requests. Reusing the same key with the same payload replays the stored response.

LimitQuery.name: limit
LimitQuery.description: Maximum number of items to return.

CursorQuery.name: cursor
CursorQuery.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

DateFromQuery.name: dateFrom
DateFromQuery.description: Inclusive lower bound on the resource creation timestamp.

DateToQuery.name: dateTo
DateToQuery.description: Inclusive upper bound on the resource creation timestamp.

WhatsAppTemplateStatusQuery.name: status
WhatsAppTemplateStatusQuery.description: Filter WhatsApp templates by Coussema template status.

WhatsAppTemplateCategoryQuery.name: category
WhatsAppTemplateCategoryQuery.description: Filter WhatsApp templates by template category.

WhatsAppConversationStatusQuery.name: status
WhatsAppConversationStatusQuery.description: Filter WhatsApp conversations by conversation state.

WhatsAppMessageStatusQuery.name: status
WhatsAppMessageStatusQuery.description: Filter WhatsApp messages by delivery state.

WhatsAppBillingCategoryQuery.name: category
WhatsAppBillingCategoryQuery.description: Filter WhatsApp messages by billing/conversation category.

WhatsAppRecipientQuery.name: recipient
WhatsAppRecipientQuery.description: Filter by recipient phone number in E.164 format.

ContactTagQuery.name: tag
ContactTagQuery.description: Filter contacts to a single tag value.

XRequestId.description: Unique request correlation id generated or echoed by the API.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Rate limit budget allocated to the authenticated API key window.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in the current API key window.

XRateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp at which the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a rate-limit rejection.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request payload, query, or header values.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key authentication.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated principal cannot access the requested organization resource.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state or a prior idempotent request.

RateLimited.description: The authenticated API key exceeded its request budget for the current window.
